title: talkies backend_config
description: Sectioned backend_config for the talkies provider (Phase 24). One talkies process runs per backend definition: the engine is launched as `<TALKIES_PYTHON> -m uvicorn talkies.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port <private>` with the TALKIES_* environment below, enabled to exactly this definition's registry slug. x-flag names the exact upstream env var this maps to; env.py remains the executable mapping. There is deliberately NO x-max-running-backends cap: VRAM admission governs how many talkies processes share a machine.

model.title: Model
model.description: The single talkies registry slug this backend serves. The driver prefetches its snapshot into $TALKIES_DATA_DIR/models/<slug> before spawn and exports it as TALKIES_ENABLED_MODELS / TALKIES_PRELOAD.

slug.title: Registry slug
slug.description: Slug of the bundled (or custom-registry) talkies model this definition serves, e.g. 'qwen3-tts-1.7b-custom' or 'whisper-large-v3-turbo'. Must exist in the registry JSON at TALKIES_MODELS_FILE; an unknown slug fails the start.

revision.title: Snapshot revision
revision.description: Optional immutable HuggingFace commit for the prefetch snapshot_download. null/absent = the registry entry's own revision (or the repo default).

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: talkies server knobs. The engine binds a private OS-assigned loopback port allocated at start (never a config field); the agent's single /v1 surface routes to it by model.

device.title: Device
device.description: Compute device: 'auto', 'cpu', 'cuda', or 'cuda:N'. The CUDA image defaults to 'cuda'; set 'cpu' only for CPU-capable slugs on a CPU box.

defaults.title: Request Defaults
defaults.description: Recorded synthesis/transcription defaults used as fallbacks when a client request omits the field (the driver fills them into the forwarded body). They never override an explicit request value.

voice.title: Default voice
voice.description: Default TTS voice name (must exist in the model's voice catalog). null/absent = the engine's model default.

language.title: Default language
language.description: Default language label for synthesis / ASR source hint. null/absent = the engine's registry default.

response_format.title: Default response format
response_format.description: Default SPEECH response_format ('pcm' selects Qwen3 incremental raw PCM + X-Sample-Rate). Applies to /v1/audio/speech only — a transcription response_format always comes from the client request and is never defaulted from here. null/absent = the engine default (mp3).

speed.title: Default speed
speed.description: Default speech speed multiplier (0.25-4.0; backend support varies). null/absent = 1.0.

instructions.title: Default instructions
instructions.description: Default Qwen3 mode instruction/voice-description text (emotion/style prompt for CustomVoice, required voice description for VoiceDesign). null/absent = none.

limits.title: Limits & Lifecycle
limits.description: Per-model admission and residency limits exported to the engine.

model_concurrency.title: Model concurrency
model_concurrency.description: Active inference requests the engine admits for this slug (HTTP ASR + TTS + live WS together; excess fails 429, never queues). Exported as TALKIES_MODEL_CONCURRENCY '<slug>=N'. Reported as effective_capacity.

max_upload_bytes.title: Max upload bytes
max_upload_bytes.description: Engine-side multipart transcription / file-stage upload cap in bytes. null/absent = talkies default (104857600).

model_ttl.title: Model idle TTL (seconds)
model_ttl.description: Idle eviction TTL exported as TALKIES_MODEL_TTL. 0 (default) disables eviction and pins the model so 'backend running' <=> weights resident, which is what keeps the admin's per-instance VRAM ledger exact. A nonzero value lets talkies unload the idle model while the backend still reports running — the VRAM accounting then UNDER-counts; only set it deliberately on shared boxes.

security.title: Security
security.description: Engine-facing shared bearer secret. talkies enforces it on every HTTP/WS route except /healthz; the driver attaches it to all proxied requests.

auth_token.title: Engine auth token
auth_token.description: Bearer token exported as TALKIES_AUTH_TOKEN. Empty (default) = the driver generates a random token per start (the engine is loopback-only inside the container, but a fixed secret is defense-in-depth). Never logged.
